messages.text: Reconcile approved organization plan OP-2027 revision 4 against Q1 funded positions and approved aggregate hiring and attrition assumptions for the Platform organization.
I bound the review to OP-2027 revision 4, checked the approved role-level privacy scope, and separated approved demand and funding facts from modeled hiring and attrition assumptions.
Make the result useful in an ordinary chat client and leave a durable handoff.

I produced outputs/workforce-plan-handoff.md and an inline review surface with exact demand-to-position reconciliation, aggregate scenario math, capability, succession, and location gaps, owner actions, and pending manager decisions. No personnel action or headcount approval occurred.
